test_title: PYST 206: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 24th Nov, 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. Some medicines are injections.

2. No injection is an equipment.

**Conclusions:**

I. No equipment is an injection.

II. No medicine is an equipment.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/063f11dbeb1cdf6049d08121383f449ed55b705b0b11bd25400fb17b78efe928.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No equipment is an injection → True (As No injection is an equipment so, No equipment is an injection is True)

II. No medicine is an equipment → False (As Some medicines are injections and No injection is an equipment so No medicine is an equipment is not a definite relation given hence, False)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I is true.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion I follows".**
